alerts.title: Yemen’s Houthis renew strikes on Saudi Arabia as UNSC extends sanctions
alerts.why: Renewed Houthi drone strikes targeting Saudi oil infrastructure raise geopolitical risk premiums and supply disruption fears in the Middle East.

alerts.title: Iran war live: Riyadh, China discuss Houthis as group claims Aramco attacks
alerts.why: Houthi drone attacks on Saudi Aramco energy facilities threaten immediate Middle East crude supply stability, driving geopolitical risk premium higher.

alerts.title: Iran targets US radar in Bahrain, reports tanker explosion in Hormuz
alerts.why: Geopolitical escalation in the Strait of Hormuz directly threatens vital crude supply choke points, risking major supply disruptions.

alerts.title: Iran threatens unlimited response over Strait of Hormuz after US attack
alerts.why: Threats to close the Strait of Hormuz and direct military escalation spike geopolitical risk premium for global crude supply.

alerts.title: Russian crude production rebounds after Trump diesel deal, IEA says as oil markets return to surplus
alerts.why: IEA reports Russian crude output rebound and global return to surplus, pressuring prices downward over the near term.

alerts.title: Iran Says Gas Tanker Hit Mine in Strait of Hormuz
alerts.why: Strait of Hormuz chokepoint disruptions threaten vital global crude supply lines, escalating geopolitical risk premiums instantly.

itemsSent.title: OPEC+ Data Deck (November 2026)
itemsSent.why: Increased Middle Eastern production outweighs geopolitical risk premiums, exerting downward pressure on crude prices despite ongoing regional instability.

itemsSent.title: EIA Data Shows Builds in Crude, Gasoline and Distillates
itemsSent.why: Across-the-board builds in crude, gasoline, and distillates signal weakening demand and oversupply, exerting downward pressure on the entire energy complex.

itemsSent.title: Fed’s Hammack backs gradual rate hikes as AI spending fuels sticky inflation
itemsSent.why: Hawkish Fed commentary suggesting higher-for-longer interest rates strengthens the dollar and pressures oil demand outlook.

itemsSent.title: EIA: US crude oil inventories up 4.7 million bbl
itemsSent.why: A 4.7 million barrel build in US crude inventories significantly exceeds market expectations, exerting downward pressure on WTI prices.

itemsSent.title: Europe Enters Winter With Its Lowest Gas Inventory of the 2020s
itemsSent.why: Low storage levels entering winter increase vulnerability to cold snaps, supporting natural gas prices despite Rystad's cautious outlook on further rallies.

itemsSent.title: IMO Secretary-General calls on States to enforce maritime rules in the Strait of Hormuz
itemsSent.why: Heightened rhetoric regarding Strait of Hormuz security adds a modest geopolitical risk premium to crude prices, though no immediate supply disruption occurred.

itemsSent.title: Venezuela Ends 19-Year Power Monopoly, With Oil Fields First in Line
itemsSent.why: Privatizing power generation for oil fields could reduce operational bottlenecks and increase production capacity in the long term, though immediate impact is limited.
